usedFor: api.video holds your uploads and streams, and Asana receives a project when “New Video Created” runs “Create Project”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Video Created” in api.video, then “Create Project” in Asana
bestTemplate.why: Each new video gets its own Asana project, so review work starts with an owner and dates.

watchOut: “New Video Created” is polling, so “Create Project” runs after a scheduled check, not when a video appears.
